h1: Land Rover BMW-Sourced V8 Hot-Vee Repair (N63/S68)
lede: Full timing-chain and engine-system overhaul for the 4.4L twin-turbo V8 found in the Defender Octa, Range Rover P530 / SV, and Range Rover Sport P530 / SV.

blocks.html: We specialise in the repair and rebuild of the BMW-sourced N63 and S68 4.4L twin-turbo V8 engines as fitted to high-performance Land Rover models. This is a specialised “hot-vee” engine where the turbochargers sit between the cylinder banks, creating unique access requirements and heat-management challenges.

Our workshop carries out complete timing-chain system replacement, full engine strip-down inspections, and component-level rebuilds using genuine BMW/JLR-spec parts and manufacturer-approved tooling. Every repair includes a thorough pre- and post-assembly diagnostic check, followed by a road test to confirm correct operation.
Work is carried out in our Essex workshop with full 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty on all parts and labour.

sections.heading: Our Process - N63 / S68 Timing Chain & Engine Repair

steps.title: Access & Preparation
steps.body: Vehicle on lift; bonnet removed. Turbocharger heat shields and pipework removed. Radiator, cooling fan, and hoses taken out. Engine oil and coolant drained.

steps.title: Removal
steps.body: Crankshaft pulley removed with holding tools. Engine set to TDC using BMW locking tools. Timing chain tensioners released; guide rails unbolted; timing chains removed from sprockets.

steps.title: Reassembly
steps.body: New timing chains, guide rails, and tensioners fitted. Timing set to manufacturer specifications using locking tools. All gaskets, seals, and single-use bolts replaced.

steps.title: Testing & Quality Control
steps.body: Engine run to operating temperature; timing verified with BMW ISTA or JLR diagnostic equipment. Full road test (up to 30 minutes) to confirm repair quality.

items.q: What does “hot-vee” mean for the N63/S68 engine?
items.a: The turbochargers are mounted between the cylinder banks (in the “V” of the engine). This compact design improves response but generates extra heat and makes the timing chain access more complex than a conventional V8 layout.

items.q: Which Land Rover models use the BMW-sourced V8?
items.a: The N63 and S68 engines are fitted to the **Defender Octa**, **Range Rover P530 / SV P615**, and **Range Rover Sport P530 / SV P635**.

items.q: What are the typical signs of timing chain wear on these engines?
items.a: Rattling noise on cold start-up, engine warning lights, reduced performance, or fault codes related to camshaft/crankshaft correlation. We recommend an inspection if you notice any of these.

items.q: How long does the repair take?
items.a: Timing chain replacement on the N63/S68 typically takes **3-5 working days** from the vehicle arriving at our workshop, depending on parts availability.

items.q: Do you offer a warranty on the repair?
items.a: Yes - all our engine repairs and rebuilds come with a **12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty** covering parts and labour.
